policy.demand_basis: 70% Artemis128 (16 KiB card), 30% Artemis256 (32 KiB card and AION system RAM). Within each tier 80% monochrome and 20% Color II: total Mono Pro uptake 24%. Previous display-specific interest uplift scaled by 24/60; price elasticity applied once afterwards. Mix and response are scenario assumptions, not observed orders. Campaign remains $435,000; no additional price/value marketing bonus.
